module_summary: 10GBASE-R 64b/66b block decoder: per-byte control-code lookup plus block-type case decode produce registered XGMII data/control, with a frame-state bit for sequence error checking.

anchors.name: encoded_rx_data
anchors.why: 64-bit encoded block payload; block type and control codes decoded from it.

anchors.name: encoded_rx_hdr
anchors.why: Sync header selects data pass-through versus control block decode, flags bad headers.

anchors.name: xgmii_rxc
anchors.why: Registered XGMII per-byte control flags output.

anchors.name: rx_bad_block
anchors.why: Registered flag for invalid header, block type or control code.

anchors.name: rx_sequence_error
anchors.why: Registered flag for start-in-frame or terminate-outside-frame errors.

anchors.name: decoded_ctrl
anchors.why: Per-byte 7-bit control codes translated to XGMII control characters.

anchors.name: decode_err
anchors.why: Per-lane invalid control code flags feeding bad-block detection.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: In-frame state set by start, cleared by terminate; checks sequence errors.

groups.name: Control code decoder
groups.description: Lookup of eight 7-bit control codes into XGMII characters with error flags.

groups.name: Block type decoder
groups.description: Header/block-type case assembles XGMII data/control and bad-block flag into output registers.

groups.name: Frame tracker
groups.description: Tracks in-frame state across start/terminate blocks to flag sequence errors.
